title: Surreal Dream Path
description: A lone hiker with backpack and walking stick stands on a winding black path through a purple flower field, looking toward a giant geometric tower of stylized faces with multiple eyes. The night sky contains a large circular portal showing a castle, string lights with symbolic faces, and a red rock canyon in the background.
prompt: Surreal night scene of a lone hiker with backpack and staff walking on a cracked black path through a vast field of purple flowers, approaching a towering geometric monument made of multiple stylized faces with many eyes, set against red rock canyon formations, above which floats a large circular portal revealing a purple starry sky with a castle and stairs, with strings of symbolic face lanterns hanging across the black sky, in a graphic illustrative style with bold white linework
